notes.title: Free Demo Now Available
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594567/1f116b8248ab7c664d3024730cf4721cefe0f8fe.png[/img][h1]It's Out![/h1]

Happy Thursday Everyone! The Hogtagon Demo has just dropped onto steam and is completely free. Come check it out and let us know what you think while we get to work on the full release.

If you want to find other people interested in giving the game a try, try our discord server and its lobby finder: https://discord.gg/U7YJGu5h
